A '''governor''' ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and later [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. Loyal to the Moff, the governor abandoned their post when ordered to by Sarne, joining his [[Moff Sarne's forces|fleet]] when it arrived at Gandle Ott following Sarne's [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|defeat]] at [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]].

==Personality and traits==
The governor was a competent administrator, and their abandonment of office threw the planet's political command structure into chaos. The governor was also more loyal to Moff Sarne than to the Galactic Empire.<ref name="dirp" />

==Behind the scenes==
The governor was mentioned in ''[[Death Is Remotely Possible]]'', the third [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] adventure in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. The governor did not appear in the adventure, having left Gandle Ott prior to the commencement of the scenario.
